about.text: Icelandic fermented whey. Whey drained from skyr or cheese is left to ferment until lactic acid bacteria turn its milk sugar sour. Mixed with water it made a common drink, sýrublanda. Before salt and refrigeration became common, food was stored in barrels of it; this sour-pickled food, súrmatur, is still eaten at the midwinter Þorri feasts.
